requirements: Users can create an account and manage a personal profile.
Users can log meals, snacks, and drinks with quantities and timestamps.
Users can search or select foods from a nutrition database.
Users can track calories, macronutrients, and other nutrition goals.
Users can edit or delete previously entered food logs.
Users can view daily, weekly, and monthly nutrition summaries.
Users can set diet goals and receive progress feedback.
Users can export or share nutrition reports.
The system should protect personal nutrition data with secure authentication.
The interface should be responsive on desktop and mobile devices.
Food search and meal logging should feel fast and remain responsive.
The system should store user history reliably and support backups.
The application should be easy to use for first-time users.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate architecture design may result in scalability and performance issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage experienced architects to review and refine the system architecture.

risk_report.risk: Poor database schema design may lead to data inconsistencies and querying issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established database modeling techniques and review schema with database experts.

risk_report.risk: Ineffective UI design may result in a poor user experience and low adoption rates.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct user experience testing and iterate on UI design based on feedback.

risk_report.mitigation: Use widely adopted and well-maintained frontend frameworks and libraries.

risk_report.mitigation: Optimize search queries and logging processes to ensure responsive performance.

risk_report.mitigation: Implement rigorous testing and validation of nutrition tracking and summary calculations.

risk_report.stage: Define system architecture and tech stack
risk_report.risk: Incompatible or outdated technology choices may lead to scalability or maintenance issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough research and pilot testing of tech stack components before finalizing architecture.

risk_report.stage: Design database schema for users, food logs, and nutrition data
risk_report.risk: Poor schema design may result in inefficient queries or data inconsistencies.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize data where necessary and use indexing strategies for performance-critical queries.

risk_report.stage: Design API endpoints for authentication, food search, and logging
risk_report.risk: API design flaws may expose security vulnerabilities or limit future extensibility.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow RESTful principles and conduct threat modeling during design.

risk_report.stage: Create UI/UX wireframes for responsive design (desktop/mobile)
risk_report.risk: Poor UX design may lead to low user adoption or accessibility issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct user testing and iterate on wireframes based on feedback.

risk_report.stage: Implement user authentication and profile management
risk_report.risk: Authentication vulnerabilities may lead to unauthorized access or data breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established libraries (e.g., OAuth2, JWT) and enforce strong password policies.

risk_report.stage: Integrate nutrition database API or build internal database
risk_report.risk: Inaccurate or incomplete nutrition data may mislead users and reduce trust.
risk_report.mitigation: Validate data sources and implement data cleaning pipelines.

risk_report.stage: Implement food logging with timestamps and quantities
risk_report.risk: Incorrect logging may lead to inaccurate nutrition tracking and user dissatisfaction.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement client-side validation and server-side reconciliation checks.

risk_report.stage: Implement search and selection from nutrition database
risk_report.risk: Slow or inaccurate search results may frustrate users and reduce engagement.
risk_report.mitigation: Optimize database queries and implement caching for frequent searches.

risk_report.risk: Calculation errors may lead to incorrect progress tracking and user distrust.
risk_report.mitigation: Use unit tests to validate calculations and cross-check with external sources.

risk_report.stage: Implement edit/delete functionality for food logs
risk_report.risk: Improper handling of edits/deletions may corrupt data integrity or violate audit trails.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement soft deletes and maintain audit logs for critical actions.

risk_report.risk: Performance issues may arise when aggregating large datasets for summaries.
risk_report.mitigation: Use materialized views or pre-aggregated tables for common time ranges.

risk_report.stage: Implement diet goal setting and progress feedback
risk_report.risk: Misaligned goals or feedback may demotivate users or provide incorrect guidance.
risk_report.mitigation: Base goals on validated nutritional standards and allow user customization.

risk_report.risk: Data leaks or formatting errors in reports may compromise user privacy or usability.
risk_report.mitigation: Sanitize data in reports and validate export formats with sample users.

risk_report.stage: Develop responsive UI for all features (desktop/mobile)
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent behavior across devices may degrade user experience.
risk_report.mitigation: Use responsive frameworks (e.g., React, Flutter) and test on multiple devices.

risk_report.stage: Unit test authentication, food logging, and tracking logic
risk_report.risk: Insufficient test coverage may allow bugs to reach production undetected.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement TDD for critical paths and maintain high test coverage metrics.

risk_report.stage: Integration test API endpoints and database interactions
risk_report.risk: Undetected integration issues may cause runtime failures in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Use contract testing and mock external dependencies during integration tests.

risk_report.stage: UI/UX testing for responsiveness and usability
risk_report.risk: Unidentified usability issues may lead to poor user retention.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct A/B testing and gather analytics on user interaction patterns.

risk_report.stage: Performance testing for fast food search and logging
risk_report.risk: Slow performance may frustrate users and reduce app adoption.
risk_report.mitigation: Simulate high load and optimize bottlenecks (e.g., database indexing, caching).

risk_report.risk: Undetected vulnerabilities may lead to data breaches or compliance violations.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage third-party security experts and conduct regular audits.

risk_report.stage: Deploy backend services to production environment
risk_report.risk: Deployment errors may cause downtime or data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Use blue-green deployments and automated rollback mechanisms.

risk_report.stage: Deploy frontend to hosting service with CDN for mobile/desktop
risk_report.risk: CDN misconfigurations may lead to slow load times or broken assets.
risk_report.mitigation: Test CDN caching policies and monitor asset delivery performance.

risk_report.stage: Set up automated backups for user data
risk_report.risk: Backup failures may result in permanent data loss during incidents.
risk_report.mitigation: Regularly test backup restoration and use geographically distributed storage.

risk_report.stage: Monitor system performance and user feedback post-deployment
risk_report.risk: Undetected issues may persist and degrade user experience over time.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement real-time monitoring and establish a feedback loop with users.
